**Saint-Aubin clinic handover — nursing coordination**

**Established:** 4,200 patients; 6 rooms; Mon–Fri 08:00–19:00, Sat 09:00–13:00. 12 nurses, 3 shifts; 4 admin. Accreditation Apr 2022–Apr 2027; renewal needs infection-control audit. ~180 consultations/day; peak 310 (Jan 2025 flu). No-shows 9%, down from 14% after Sept 2024 reminder texts.

**Fixed:** Mar 2024 fridge failure (€2,100 lost) — networked alarm, checked daily, paper log backup (alarm failed silently once). Nov 2024 allergy field overwritten — records now lock while open.

**Rules:** No renewal without consultation within 12 months (38 breaches found). Vaccine stock counted twice weekly. Excursions >8°C reported same day to regional agency.

**Open:** Second ultrasound postponed June 2025 pending utilisation study — not done; saturation unknown. Coordinator vacant since Aug 2025; two senior nurses rotating; unsustainable past winter.
